faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers on pricing, multi-drop routes, COD remittance, and live parcel tracking.
faq.q1: Do I need to log in before booking a delivery?
faq.a1: No. You can fill in pickup and drop-off details, add multi-drop stops, and view live estimated delivery fees right away. Phone verification is only requested when confirming payment or saving a draft.
faq.q2: How are delivery fees calculated for single and multi-stop orders?
faq.a2: Instant delivery starts from $1.75, Same-Day from $1.25, and Tomorrow Scheduled from $1.00 depending on route distance. Each extra drop-off destination adds $0.75, and you can auto-optimize stop order to shorten distance.
faq.q3: How does Cash on Delivery (COD) work?
faq.a3: You can set an optional COD amount on each drop-off stop. Our courier collects cash from your buyer upon delivery and remits it to your seller balance. COD is tracked separately and is never added to your delivery fee.
faq.q4: Can I dispatch multiple drop-offs or import from a spreadsheet?
faq.a4: Yes. Add multiple sequential destinations inside a single booking or use Bulk Import to paste CSV rows with phone numbers, addresses, optional names, COD amounts, and rider notes.
faq.a5: On the Review & Payment screen, sellers can pay with KHQR, Cash on Pickup directly with the courier, Wing Wallet balance, or card.
faq.q6: How do recipients track their delivery?
faq.a6: Once confirmed, you receive a booking reference and live tracking link showing courier assignment, transit updates, and delivery completion that you can copy and share directly with customers.
faq.supportPrompt: Still have questions? Call Seller Support at
faq.stillHaveQuestionsSubtitle: We understand. Let's get in touch directly with our team, then.
